title: Interaction benchmark result record
description: One record per measured visit of one case. Failed visits are records too (failure non-null); they are never dropped. See CONTRACT.md for case ids and timing definitions.

runId.description: Identifies one runner invocation; shared by every record it produced.

variant.description: Configuration label, e.g. default, tuned, packed, unpacked.

versions.description: Exact installed package versions keyed by package name (framework, router, runtime, compiler, adapter, bundler).

id.description: Value of <meta name="benchmark:build"> observed in the response body.

sourceRevision.description: Git commit (plus -dirty marker when applicable) the build was produced from.

cacheState.description: Browser/CDN cache posture of the visit. A cold browser is not a cold CDN or function.

responseEvidence.description: Document response evidence: HTTP protocol, content-encoding, cache headers (e.g. x-vercel-cache), status.

slowdown.description: CPU throttling rate; 1 means unthrottled. WebKit cannot throttle and records 1.

phase.description: early: input issued as soon as the target is hittable, downloads may be pending. settled: input after the load-settle rule in CONTRACT.md.

visitIndex.description: 0-based fresh-visit index within this (entrant, variant, case, phase, browser, profile) cell.

order.description: Global 0-based execution order within the run, used to audit alternation between entrants.

navToResponseMs.description: Navigation start to the presentation estimate of the correct response.

inputToResponseMs.description: Measured input event timeStamp to the presentation estimate (first rAF+paint after the assertion holds). Labeled presentation estimate.

inputToDomMs.description: Measured input event timeStamp to the first observed DOM state satisfying the assertion (DOM mutation diagnostic).

eventDurationMs.description: Browser-observed Event Timing duration for the measured input, when the browser supports it; null otherwise.

pendingMs.description: settings-submit*: input to pending UI visible (local update only).

serverMs.description: settings-submit*: requestStart to responseEnd of POST /api/settings (server round trip, includes the fixed 300 ms delay).

compressedJs.description: Transfer (encoded body) bytes of JS responses up to the response.

other.description: Encoded bytes of all remaining responses (data, fonts, framework payloads).

initial.description: Requests started from navigation until the measured input.

perAction.description: Requests started from the measured input until the response (including the settings API call).

perActionDocument.description: Document (full page) requests started by the measured input; nonzero on a navigation case means no client-side navigation.
